payment.cancelledNotEditable: A cancelled payment is kept as it is: it can no longer be changed.
payment.methodRequired: Say how the client paid before recording the payment.
payment.notOpenOnCreation: A new payment is always waiting to be paid: it is recorded as paid afterwards.
payment.paidInTheFuture: A payment cannot be recorded as paid on a day still to come.
payment.paidNotEditable: A paid payment is never changed: cancel it and a new one takes its place.
payment.quoteNotAccepted: Only an accepted quote has payments.
payment.statusChangeNotAllowed: A payment that is {{from}} cannot become {{to}}.
